prayerExcerpt.en-US: The beginning of true virtue is most ardently to desire it, and to ask it of God with the utmost assiduity and earnestness.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O princípio da verdadeira virtude é desejá-la com o maior ardor, e pedi-la a Deus com a máxima assiduidade e seriedade.

meta.face: A Saxon matron of about sixty-five with a fair, fresh, lightly ruddy complexion and a BROAD, SQUARE, strong-boned face — a wide, low forehead, a SHORT nose with a broad, flat bridge, a PROMINENT, SQUARE jaw softening into slight jowls, small, deep-set, twinkling grey eyes in a web of laughter lines, straight, fair-grey brows, a wide, thin-lipped mouth in a kindly half-smile; hair hidden under the wimple; the gaze warm and attentive, toward the sick.
meta.basis: No likeness from life; the chronicle drawings on Wikipedia (Commons) show a crowned, veiled queen without individual features. The book's engraving shows her serving the sick with a cup; her foundation and burial at Quedlinburg are from Wikipedia. The broad, square Saxon face is our choice, apart from the set's long-faced queens.
